big_case.notes: Plenary SG cert grant testing whether a flagship presidential border proclamation (Proclamation No. 10,888) can invoke 8 U.S.C. 1182(f), 1185(a)(1), and 1158(b)(1)(A) to categorically foreclose asylum at the southern border, alongside whether 8 U.S.C. 1252(f)(1) bars classwide injunctive relief against implementation of a Part II proclamation. High national policy salience and major separation-of-powers and remedial consequences across immigration enforcement, bounded slightly only because it turns on statutory interpretation rather than constitutional invalidation.
